chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Hasan ibn Ali from Ja'far ibn Muhammad from Abdullah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah from Ja'far from his father from their fathers, peace be upon them, said:

The sun was eclipsed during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), so he led the people in two rak'ahs, prolonging [the prayer] until some of the people behind him fainted due to the length of standing.
ai.seo_question: How long did the Prophet stand during the eclipse prayer according to this narration?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his progeny) leading the eclipse prayer (*Salat al-Kusuf*) with prolonged standing, a practice that underscores the physical devotion required in this specific ritual. The detail that some followers fainted emphasizes the intensity and length of the recitation and standing, distinguishing it from regular prayers and reflecting the Prophetic tradition of extending worship during celestial signs.
